bear_case: The STEP_ASIDE verdict understates the probability of a full BEARISH conversion before June 24's catalysts arrive. ES futures at -0.2% with SPX just 12.79 pts above the 7,460 floor means a single risk-off event Tuesday morning — a third GOOGL departure headline, a Trump-Iran escalation, or a FedEx guidance cut after close — gaps SPX below 7,460 before the Micron earnings and NVDA Annual Meeting have any chance to deliver. BTC at $62,325 is not hovering near the $63,500 stop; it is $1,175 below it — recovery of that magnitude requires a specific catalyst that is absent on a Tuesday with no scheduled macro data. The Brent -3.3% session reduced an inflationary headwind, but $77.90 is still above the disinflation-equilibrium of $70-75 implied by the Iran deal: supply normalization has been priced but not delivered. Counter-argument invalidation: if SPX holds above 7,480 at the June 23 close AND BTC recovers above $63,500 by midnight UTC → HOLD restored. If SPX closes below 7,460 today, call moves to BEARISH immediately.
